facts.statement: The Beta phase had ended by the time of this post, and the game was presented as fully available with membership upgrades.
facts.quote: The Beta phase is over, and now there’s even more to do and see!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post (captured May 2, 2009) announcing that the Beta phase is over and that players can upgrade to a paid Membership. It says Members get exclusive content, additional Jobs including Wizard and Warrior, leaderboard access, and more than one character, for $4.99 per month plus applicable taxes.
